method: Beast: each fight must contain an observed initial-form rage hit, its unique rage notification matched to the exact battle interval, or an actual first-form-to-successor transition, and naturally end in an Elder loss. A successor transition establishes progress beyond the first-form threshold, but does not assert that the rage callback was observed. EXUSIAI: each six-fight group must have mean and median full-chain net HP loss within 50-80 percent. Every row must naturally lose; no wins are accepted. Draws, timeouts, phase failures and errors are not accepted.
boundary: A positive initial-form rage hit records the executed shooter rage flag. Zero such hits do not establish absence of rage. Final Beast HP is retained for reference and is not attributed entirely to Elder damage because Beast also drains its own HP. Execution, candidate identity, display continuity and save protection require their separate receipts. These results do not certify human or standard-entry acceptance.
